title: Shorter Block Names
description: Changes "Block of X" to "X Block" and "Y Stained Glass" to "Y Glass"
body:
Renames ore blocks and stained glass blocks/panes. For example:
- "Block of Iron" -> "Iron Block"
- "Yellow Stained Glass" -> "Yellow Glass"
- "Black Stained Glass Pane" -> "Black Glass Pane"
